title: ISO 10828:2024 — Worm gears — Worm profiles and gear mesh geometry
locator: Official catalogue abstract and scope: five common worm profile types A, C, I, K and N; formulae for axial profiles, path of contact, conjugate worm-wheel profile and gear mesh geometry
notes: The 2024 International Standard cancels and replaces ISO/TR 10828:2015. It is a geometry source, not a machine-tool rotary table acceptance standard or a load-rating guarantee. Standard full text is not archived.
